summary: Source implementer guidance for original-baseline consumption/direct capture, proportionate feedback and submission/correction evidence. Reviewer integration, live agent compliance and the full installed journey remain unqualified.

provides.name: implementer-starting-evidence
provides.summary: Packaged entry validates the supplied baseline's logical project, inventory/source hashes, effective tools/settings/checks and folder coverage before editing; material mismatch returns to focused preflight without replacement capture or relaxed high-assurance freshness. Direct self-preflight attempts installation-local pre-edit capture of authorized supported Python folders, including test/eval/harness assets and existing empty parents, using actual dirty/staged/untracked worktree bytes. No package solely for measurement, implicit setup or cross-installation fallback.

provides.name: proportionate-implementer-comparison
provides.summary: Compare final changed/added/deleted Python paths against the original captured coverage. Attribute affected responsibilities from diff and context, assess extractions with helpers, and leave untouched siblings as context. Below-target growth needs no defense. Explain retained new/newly crossed breaches, worsening breaches and materially edited legacy hotspots still above target, naming report/function/metric, known before/after, cohesion and a plausible alternative's cost. Recover missing rationale without automatic threshold rejection or metric-driven splitting, hidden arguments, tuned settings or unrelated cleanup.

provides.name: implementer-submission-and-correction-handoff
provides.summary: Implementer side of IF-003 only: existing initial/correction formats carry original/current report pairs, coverage/status/gaps, affected-function relationships, required rationale, transfer paths and current native evidence. Corrections preserve the original baseline and prior reports, use fresh comparisons and stale affected evidence/verdicts while retaining existing ledger identities and conditional stage order. Required native checks keep command, whole-project scope, policy and owner; aggregate reuse needs established constituent coverage and current bytes. Machine results use existing fields or authorized linked artifacts without schema extensions. Independent reviewer comparison/disposition is not implemented by this entry.

artifacts.name: implementer-report-and-rationale-references
artifacts.summary: Existing submission/correction artifacts reference exact original JSON/text and fresh current comparison pairs, governed/affected scope, status, gaps/recovery owner and retained-breach rationale. Direct capture supplies the same original-baseline contract. Scope expansion requires authorization and exact preserved pre-edit supplemental evidence or an explicit unrecoverable gap. Isolated consumers receive exact source/receiving paths for both siblings; ignored reports do not travel with commits.

artifacts.name: implementer-native-evidence-reference
artifacts.summary: Native evidence beside metrics carries exact command, governed scope/policy, checked-byte identity, result and producer/stage; aggregate coverage/reuse or owed duties/owner remain explicit. Direct self-preflight discovers the same obligations as packaged entry from existing policy or documented commands, recording none when absent. Successful or N/A metrics cannot waive required native failures or missing/stale proof. Optional run-evidence availability remains separate; wrapping a real comparison does not require duplicate measurement or a new lifecycle.

artifacts.name: implementer-measurement-eval-preparation
artifacts.summary: Task-owned finite scenario inputs and setup/check commands cover entry, thresholds, attribution, corrections, evidence gaps, native duties and optional instrumentation while retaining existing entry/route/review cases. Setup requires the source distribution, disposable authorized roots and an already pinned interpreter; it installs only into disposable targets and never provisions dependencies. Local fixture checks exercise supplied states, numeric comparisons and native success/failure/correction boundaries. Prepared artifact/diff/order/rationale oracles do not prove agent behavior; live evals and T-005 installed composition remain unqualified.

invariants.statement: Advisory metrics do not waive required native policy, scope or ownership. Aggregate evidence is reused only for established constituent coverage and current bytes; missing/stale required proof stays owed to its owner.

Keep one original actual pre-edit baseline through corrections and retain prior reports. Never overwrite either sibling or relabel edited code as starting evidence. Capture preserves source/index and never implicitly provisions tools.

Tool/settings/check/scope compatibility and exact report paths govern applicability. Missing counts and unmatched symbols remain unknown. Docs-only/unsupported scope is N/A; incomplete/stale/uncovered evidence cannot claim a clean comparison. Recover when feasible; advisory absence blocks only under explicit indispensable-evidence authority.
Rationale follows actually affected responsibilities. Below-target growth and untouched debt require no metric-driven refactor; smaller numbers do not excuse worse ownership, names or navigation.

Changed bytes stale affected evidence and verdicts; preserve existing conditional stage order and affected-scope re-entry. Measurement warnings add no review stage and implementation measurement is not independent review.
